quotes.title: Relaxed stay at the Fairmont in Tangier
quotes.name: Ben
quotes.quote: Really relaxed stay at the Fairmont in Tangier. A special experience while discovering a new culture during Ramadan. Service and hospitality were incredible! Booking process was smooth despite me requesting to change the dates after my initial booking which is really reassuring.

quotes.title: Highly recommend Holiwise
quotes.name: Natalya
quotes.quote: I had a truly wonderful experience with Holiwise! Everything was perfectly organized, and the attention to detail made the entire trip smooth and stress-free. A special highlight was the booking at the Four Seasons Resort Seychelles at Desroches Island. It was absolutely amazing and exceeded all expectations. The team was friendly, responsive, and clearly passionate about creating memorable travel experiences.

quotes.title: Trip to Copenhagen
quotes.name: Kevin
quotes.quote: After booking a hotel with Holiwise last summer, which was super easy and came with great service, I’ve now booked a flight from Prague to Copenhagen. As a still somewhat price sensitive traveler, I appreciated that Holiwise not only made the process seamless but also offered the best price.

quotes.title: Exceeded all expectations and beyond!
quotes.name: Angel
quotes.quote: I used their concierge service and wow it was such a breeze! The concierge was very responsive, attentive and super efficient. I booked all my hotels within the same day… and at much better prices than other websites! I will use Holiwise for all my future vacations and I highly recommend!

quotes.title: Great booking experience
quotes.name: Kevin
quotes.quote: I’ve had the pleasure of booking hotels through Holiwise for several of my trips this year, and I’ll definitely continue using their service in the future. The selection has been excellent for my destinations (Madrid, Milan, and Belgrade), and the support during the booking process has been outstanding. If you’re looking for everything you could wish for when planning your travels, I highly recommend Holiwise.

quotes.title: Hotel bookings
quotes.name: Qalbee
quotes.quote: Recommendation from a friend, and honestly, I pretty much knew what I wanted going in. The agent, Kristian, helped by finding competitive hotel prices and making sure everything lined up. Overall, I’m really happy with the service and would definitely recommend it!

faq.heading: Good to know
faq.intro: Anything else, message us and a person will reply.

items.a: A private, invitation-only membership. Members get their own travel agent on WhatsApp, member rates at over 1 million stays, and partner privileges like upgrades and breakfast where available.
No. There is no membership fee. You pay for your trips, at member rates.
Use the invitation a member sent you, or request one with the form on this page. Someone from our team reads every request.

items.q: How long does it take to hear back about my request?
items.a: We reply to every request personally, by email or on WhatsApp. If a member invited you, have their code to hand.

items.q: What kind of trips can my agent help with?
items.a: Anything travel-related: a hotel for the weekend, flights, or a longer trip across several places. Simple stays come back quickly; bigger trips get the time they deserve.

items.q: What are the requirements to join?
items.a: Premium is designed for people who travel often. Tell us a little about how you travel and we will take it from there.
Yes. Choose Company on the request form and tell us about the way your team travels.

items.q: Can I invite friends or family?
items.a: Yes. Members can share invitation links with the people they travel with.
Membership is personal and non-transferable, and is offered in line with our terms.

hero.headline: Travel, looked after by people.
hero.intro: We help you experience the world effortlessly. A travel agency of real people in London and Stockholm, with technology we built ourselves working quietly behind every trip.
hero._note: Hero photos from Figma 393:3687. Several are Belmond images used as internal placeholders: not licensed for public use.

story.lead: If you’re reading this, it’s probably because you love to travel. So do we. We’re frequent travellers based in London and Stockholm, with backgrounds at Goldman Sachs, Spotify, Microsoft and Barclays. Over years of travelling, we found the trip was always the best part, and the planning, with a dozen tabs open to research, compare and book, the worst.
paragraphs: So we built a travel agency that does the planning for you. Tell your agent where and when, and they come back with a few options that fit. Behind them, technology we built ourselves matches hotels and rooms to how you like to travel, so your agent’s time goes on you.

Simple stays come back quickly. Bigger trips, with flights, several stops and a few weeks away, get the time they deserve. For people who travel often there is Holiwise Premium: your own agent, member rates at over 1 million stays, and partner privileges on every trip. It’s by invitation.
